baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired NZL forms at words 2 and 7 contrast two possible agents, while word 4 names the cloud source.
baseline_models.mechanism: Descent and settling supply the observed motion; causative delivery supplies the disputed agency that makes water arrive from the cloud.

activation_trace.role: Falling and settling give the water its literal downward trajectory and endpoint.
Causing something to descend and reach its recipient makes effective delivery the agency under question.
The cloud or rain-cloud supplies the elevated source from which delivery occurs.

changed_reading.after: The verse isolates agency behind the fall: water descends and settles, but the disputed act is who causes it to reach recipients from the cloud.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative NZL pair and al-muzn permit a material reading of release from a filled source into fitting destinations.
baseline_models.mechanism: A cloud imagined through filling becomes a charged vessel; NZL as putting a thing in its station makes rainfall ordered placement rather than undirected dropping.

activation_trace.role: Filling a waterskin supplies the exploratory image of the cloud as a charged container.
Putting a thing in its proper station turns release from the cloud into situated distribution.

changed_reading.before: Rain is only downward motion from a cloud.
changed_reading.after: Rain can be heard as supply released from a charged cloud-vessel and put into fitting earthly stations.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The NZL forms and al-muzn join branches of prepared guest-provision and cloudlike generosity.
baseline_models.mechanism: The cloud is not only a source body: its generosity is delivered as nuzul, provision prepared for those dependent on what descends.

activation_trace.role: Provision prepared for a guest supplies the hospitality image carried by the act of sending down.
Resembling the cloud in generosity makes the source a figure of unstinting beneficence.

changed_reading.before: The cloud is merely the physical source of rain.
changed_reading.after: The cloud becomes a figure of generosity, and the descent becomes prepared provision for dependent recipients.

context_deltas.mechanism: The semen/creation pair separates a humanly handled input from the origination completed through it; the repeated agency contrast transfers that causal boundary to water delivered from clouds.

activation_trace.role: Effective delivery anchors the focus question at the transition from available source to arriving water.
Origination supplies the completed generative act contrasted with the audience's proximal involvement.
Semen from which creation is measured supplies the handled material that does not itself explain origination.

structural_cues: 56:58-59 pairs a human bodily input with the same 'you ... or We' agency contrast used at 56:69.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies seminal material and origination; I infer that the repeated contrast marks a boundary between proximal handling and generative completion, while a live alternative is a general power argument without layered causation.

changed_reading.before: Humans do not make rain fall.
changed_reading.after: Humans may handle water after arrival, but 56:69 locates the source-to-delivery transition itself beyond their authorship, parallel to material emission without authorship of creation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured governance distributed among recipients activates NZL's placement branch: precipitation becomes apportioned arrival, not merely bulk downward motion.

activation_trace.role: Putting a thing in its fitting station anchors rainfall as placement into destinations.
Governance by measure and deliberation supplies an ordering principle for the descent.
The interval among parties supplies the distributive field across which measured placement operates.

structural_cues: The first-person plural apportionment in 56:60 precedes and grammatically echoes the first-person plural sender in 56:69.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured governance 'among you' and fitting placement; I infer an analogous spatial apportionment of rain, while the live alternative is that 56:60 concerns mortality alone.

changed_reading.before: Rain is caused to fall from above.
changed_reading.after: Rain is caused to arrive by measure across recipients and places, making descent an act of allocation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Seed-casting, actual growth, possible shattering, and deprivation form a dependency chain; cloud delivery becomes an upstream gate within that chain rather than an isolated weather event.

activation_trace.role: Delivery anchors rain as the enabling transfer on which the agricultural sequence depends.
Casting seed supplies the humanly performed opening operation of the chain.
Germination and growth supply the distinct outcome that human sowing cannot secure.
Dry matter broken into fragments supplies the reversible failure state of the crop.
Loss of the sought result names the chain's terminal deprivation.

structural_cues: The sowing/growing/failure unit at 56:63-67 leads directly into the water unit at 56:68-70.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies human sowing, nonhuman growth, crop failure, and deprivation; I infer that rain delivery is an upstream control point in the same chain, while the live alternative is a sequence of separate examples joined only by rhetoric.

changed_reading.before: 56:69 denies human control of a meteorological event.
changed_reading.after: 56:69 identifies the delivery gate that connects cloud storage to growth and exposes the limits of human control over the whole food-producing chain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus is bracketed by water as consumed and by its possible bitter-salty transformation; sending down therefore includes beneficial qualification, not quantity or motion alone.

activation_trace.role: The rain-cloud supplies the source whose output is evaluated for human use.
Delivery makes the source's output reach the consumer in a consequential state.
Water itself fixes the referent carried into the focus verse.
Taking in liquid supplies potability as the practical endpoint of descent.
Bitter salty water supplies the live counter-state that would defeat drinking despite successful descent.
Recognition of benefit marks drinkable delivery as a received good rather than a neutral transfer.

structural_cues: 56:68 names the water that is drunk; 56:69 asks who sends it; 56:70 poses its bitter-salty counterfactual and calls for gratitude.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies drinking, cloud delivery, an undrinkable counter-state, and gratitude; I infer that effective sending includes arrival in a usable quality, while a live alternative locates the quality change only after descent.

changed_reading.before: The question concerns who moves water from cloud to earth.
changed_reading.after: The question concerns who delivers water from cloud to consumer as drinkable benefit; mere downward transfer would not complete the act.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gratitude for water and fire made useful in empty terrain activate the focus branches of cloud-generosity and nuzul prepared for a guest, recasting rain as hospitality for exposed dependents.

activation_trace.role: Prepared provision for a guest supplies the focus's branch-distant hospitality mechanism.
Cloudlike generosity casts the source as a benefactor rather than a neutral container.
Acknowledging the giver confirms that the delivered water is framed as benefaction.
Useful equipment for needs supplies a neighboring model of provision that enables survival.
Empty terrain lacking goods supplies the exposed recipient for whom prepared provision matters.

structural_cues: The water unit closes with gratitude at 56:70, and the fire unit closes with utility for those in empty terrain at 56:73.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gratitude, useful provision, and empty terrain; I infer an analogy that activates NZL hospitality for rain, while the live alternative keeps provision language local to water-benefit and fire without lexicalizing the descent as guest-fare.

changed_reading.before: Rain is a beneficial natural delivery.
changed_reading.after: Rain is exploratory divine hospitality: cloud-generosity sends prepared sustenance to recipients exposed like travelers in an empty land.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant WSM target mapped from the QAC root of 'name' at 56:74. It remains anchored through the focus cloud and NZL placement plus the packet's explicit image of first rain marking earth with vegetation; downstream prose should present it only as a split-root activation, not as the direct lexical sense or syntax of 56:69.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The cloud at word 4 and the causative NZL pair at words 2 and 7 provide rain that can visibly mark the receiving earth.

activation_trace.role: The rain-cloud supplies the material source of the mark.
Putting a thing into its fitting station makes the earth the receiving surface of descent.
The split target's first rain marking earth with vegetation activates descent as visible inscription.

changed_reading.before: Rain is liquid delivered from cloud to ground.
changed_reading.after: Rain can be carried as a visible mark written onto the earth, so the descent enacts a sign linked exploratorily to naming the Lord.

strongest_changes: The creation parallel recasts 56:69 as a boundary between proximal human handling and effective generative delivery.
The agricultural sequence makes rain an upstream control point in a vulnerable food-production chain.
The drinking and bitter-salty frame makes potable quality part of what successful sending down accomplishes.
summary.what_was_special: NZL supported delivery, measured placement, and hospitality at once; the split WSM target at 56:74 additionally activated rain as an earth-marking sign without displacing the stronger causal readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The filled-vessel and hospitality models are branch-distant material analogies rather than direct contextual senses.
Measured spatial allocation is inferred from the mortality apportionment and may be only a rhetorical parallel.
The packet leaves open whether drinkable quality belongs intrinsically to descent or to a subsequent transformation.
